UNION ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at
SELECT MAX(week_ending_date) AS max_week, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key, week_ending_date)) AS distinct_keys FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-20'

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS week_end, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units,
         LAG(closing_units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key ORDER BY week_ending_date) AS prev_units
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-13'
)
SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units = prev_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unchanged, SUM(closing_units) AS total_units
FROM w GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
